prefix_note: frames 0-20 (ticks -20..0) of every clip of a window, continuations and reference, are the same pixels: the released VQ tokenizer round trip of the real history (ticks -14..0: the official conditioning encode of 15 frames + 1 zero frame, decoded with z_to_clips_all; ticks -20..-15: the same encode of ticks -20..-6, positions 0..5). Deterministic (VQ argmin). The model reads ticks -14..0 (15 frames, 1.4 s) and their past ego poses.
reference: frames 0-20 = the shared prefix; frames 21-80: each real future frame t tokenised as the newest of a 15-frame causal window (encode real t-14..t + zero frame, position 14) and decoded like a generated frame (released z_to_clips on the 16-frame token window t-15..t); run drivingworld-<split>-*-recon; no randomness
